claim: Enterprise conversational voice agents are being positioned as organizational interfaces connected to knowledge and systems.
verifiedFacts: ElevenLabs announced a $300M employee tender valuing it at $22B.
ElevenLabs released v4 and v4 Turbo.
It describes agents connected to organizational knowledge and systems.
inference: Verified: voice is being packaged as an organizational interaction platform.
Inferred: multimodal knowledge access could become a bounded service.
Unknown: whether voice improves outcomes over text.
significance: Reinforces Eve as a multimodal interface experiment.
assumptions: Voice lowers friction for some knowledge tasks.
knownLimitations: Tender is secondary liquidity, not a primary raise.
